'''Rak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the military forces of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Aldreraanian Great House]] of [[House Rist|Rist]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. During the war he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] at House Rist's satellite relay, where he held command during an attack by Republic aligned individuals who killed him and disabled the relay.
